notes.title: SUPER CELEBRATION SOFTWAVES
notes.content:
Hello guys.

We come through this announcement to bring great news to all of you ːsteammockingː!


[h2]THE SPECIALTY OF THE EVENT[/h2]
You must be wondering why we do this event, and the answer is simple: [b]we are celebrating 6 years of Softwaves in the market[/b] ːsteamhappyː.

Well, time goes by so fast, right? 6 years have passed since our first release ([i]I remember it like it was yesterday[/i]).

We couldn't let such a special date go unnoticed, and that's why we're doing this super commemorative event, entitled [b]SUPER CELEBRATION SOFTWAVES[/b].


[h2]ABOUT THE EVENT[/h2]
[h3]PART 1 - Tasks[/h3]
From February 11 to February 25, 2023 some of our titles will have some "tasks" to be done by players that will generate rewards. See below the tasks ːsteamsaltyː and their respective rewards ːsteamthumbsupː.

[list]
[*] [b]Freight Simulator[/b]
ːsteamsaltyː Task: Reach the balance of F$1,000,00.00 in the business account.
ːsteamthumbsupː Reward: 01 (one) Steam Activation Key for the game Duty in the Forest [i]OR[/i] 01 (one) Steam Activation Key for the game Island Domination.

[*] [b]Mission Z[/b]
ːsteamsaltyː Task: Finish the mission "The grand finale".
ːsteamthumbsupː Reward: 01 (one) Steam Activation Key for Duty in the Forest [i]OR[/i] 01 (one) Steam Activation Key for Island Domination [i]OR[/i] 01 (one) Steam Activation Key for Transporter Manager Tycoon - Mods on the DLC Road.

[*] [b]Transporter Manager Tycoon[/b]
ːsteamsaltyː Task: Acquire a Warehouse in the game.
ːsteamthumbsupː Reward: 01 (one) Steam Activation Key for Duty in the Forest [i]OR[/i] 01 (one) Steam Activation Key for Island Domination [i]OR[/i] 01 (one) Steam Activation Key for Mission Z: Climates DLC.
[/list]
[i]To get your prize, just send an image proving that you have completed the objective in our community tab on Steam, or by Discord, or by email.[/i]

[h3]PART 2 - Questions and suggestions[/h3]
In all our games, a topic entitled "Questions and Suggestions" was opened, in the "Community Hub" tab, where we will open spaces [b]for users to ask a question[/b] [u]related to the game[/u] or [u]Softwaves[/u], [b]or even send suggestions[/b] for improvement for the game.

The selected questions/suggestions will be answered by the team and [b]we will award the selected ones[/b] ːsteamhappyː, the awards could be, alternatively:

[list]
[*] 01 (one) Steam activation key for the game Duty in the Forest.
[*] 01 (one) Steam activation key for the Island Domination game.
[*] 01 (one) Steam activation key for the Mission Z: Climates DLC.
[*] 01 (one) Steam activation key for the Transporter Manager Tycoon DLC - Mods on the Road.
[/list]
[i]Questions/suggestions will be selected and answered after the event ends on February 26, 2023[/i]

[h2]THE GOOD NEWS[/h2]
For 14 days (starting February 11, 2023) [b]ALL of our titles will be at incredible discounts[/b], [u][b]historic prices, never seen before[/b][/u].

This way, you can buy that game you have on your wishlist (the one you've been waiting for the perfect moment, a super discount), or take the opportunity to get to know some of our other titles, for a very affordable price (we would be right to say unmissable, is not?)

ːsteamthisː [b]Take advantage of unmissable discounts.[/b] ːsteamthisː


[h2]PROJECTIONS FOR THE FUTURE[/h2]
We are working on new titles, soon we will announce them to you.

My boss forgive me, but I can't keep it a secret ːsteamfacepalmː, I'm going to give some spoilers about what's to come: We're working on a new mission game, where you'll have the freedom to choose which adventure you want to face, with customization of equipment and lots of awesome mechanics. 

Also, we're working on a new tycoon game, with tons of management options, and a surprising theme (you'll be blown away).

Soon we will update you about the new titles that are coming ːsteammockingː.


[h2]BUNDLES[/h2]
I don't want to influence anyone to make good choices, but have you seen this? 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/18987/New_Waves/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/24304/All_in__Mission_Z/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/24305/All_in__Transporter_Manager_Tycoon/

[h2]OUR TITLES ON PROMOTION[/h2]
In addition, as stated earlier, [b]all our titles are LOW, HISTORICAL PRICES[/b]. Take a look:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1208950/Freight_Simulator/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1401750/Mission_Z/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1513580/Transporter_Manager_Tycoon/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1561020/Island_Domination/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1561480/Duty_in_the_Forest/


[h2]ALL OUR GAMES[/h2]
Here you can see all our games, and even leave that follow to give us a go:

https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/softwaves


[h3]What did you think of this event ːsteamthumbsupː ːsteamthumbsdownː? Comment there so we can improve or even bring it back in the future.[/h3]

notes.title: DLC release - Mission Z: Climates
notes.content:
Finally, the big day has arrived!

We are delighted to announce the release of Mission Z's first DLC, Climates.
In this DLC players will be able to test new visuals and new difficulties on the map, facing rain and snow, renewing the game with each choice.

[b]In celebration, Mission Z is at a historic 50% discount. As well as the DLC with a 33% launch discount[/b]

[h3]To learn more about the DLC go to:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1860910/Mission_Z__Climates/

notes.title: DLC on the way
notes.content:
After the release of Mission Z and various fixes, we have finally arrived at a stable and complete version of the game. And so we started working on a DLC, and we thought it would be nice to have something that made some general changes to the map. And now, you will be able to test new difficulties and new details with the Mission Z: Climates DLC, which will offer a new experience for players, including rain or snow in Mission Z, and you can choose which is the best.

[b]So, on March 4, 2022, Mission Z will get its first DLC.[/b]

[h3]See how the DLC turned out here, and add it to your wishlist.[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1860910/Mission_Z__Climates/

notes.title: Update 2.0
notes.content:
Hello survivors.

We are always listening to our community and improving our game. In this patch we take the biggest suggestions from the community and the most recurring errors to fix and added some other things. 

See what we've done below:

[list]
[*] [h2]Tutorials[/h2]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38611626/be8c690738df50ef1995bc27487f0a656a68472b.png[/img]

Now before starting the game a tutorial window will be shown, which [b]will teach you the basics about the game[/b]. 

We did this because we noticed that many people were lost in the game, not knowing what to do or where to go, and we don't want that to happen anymore. We noticed that some people didn't even manage to do the first mission, because they didn't notice the distance between the objective that is just below the map or because they didn't press the "O" button to see the objective. 

In addition, the game will now show your current mission when you enter and when you finish some other mission, thus making the game much more intuitive.

[list]
[*] [h2]In-game objective indication signs[/h2]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38611626/8e229c9072c2dc4900ced9800ec901bbee7854c0.png[/img]

All missions now have [b]signs indicating where you should go to find your objectives.[/b]

The signs will be visible on the mini-map and on the location of the objective.

We did this for the same reason that we explained earlier, some players had a lot of difficulty identifying the missions and locating themselves on the map, we did it to facilitate the gameplay and understanding of the game for some people.

[list]
[*] [h2]Removal of bugs in the launcher that prevented the game from starting[/h2]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38611626/b156609a47fac137676e5bba6dad025f73df327d.png[/img]

Some players reported that there was a bug in the launcher that was preventing the game from starting, and that after this bug occurred, even if they restarted the launcher the game was not starting. 

[b]We identified this bug and it was fixed[/b], so if you had this problem, you can now start the game normally.

[list]
[*] [h2]General optimizations[/h2]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38611626/831b069982260d2fae96fb9c49da55097b00836c.png[/img]

Many people were experiencing performance problems in the game, with the game running at [b]low FPS[/b], making it almost impossible to play. So, in order to improve the game for these people [b]we made a general optimization and now the game is much more optimized[/b]. 

But we still recommend that people who don't have very good videocards or processors make use of the graphic quality in "Low" so that the FPS doesn't have such a significant reduction.

[list]
[*] [h2]Improved artificial intelligence[/h2]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38611626/fbf6463c25ac8496919baba3ac4d1866160e441b.png[/img]

After seeing that artificial intelligence was facing some problems with player identification, [b]we made some improvements and now Martin's robots are a little smarter[/b]. 

We know that artificial intelligence is not perfect so far, but we are dedicating a lot to it and soon it will be even better.

[b]But remember, artificial intelligence varies according to the chosen game difficulty.[/b]

Be careful not to die too much in?!

[list]
[*] [h2]Removal of minor bugs in the game (texture bugs, invisible walls, etc.)[/h2]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38611626/f973e58ca7fa4ff0fef690e52bfbdedb8d94734a.png[/img]

We were also aware of some bugs in the game, such as the failure to open inventory after opening the store, texture bugs, invisible wall bugs, among others. [b]All the bugs that the community reported us or that we ended up discovering through Mission Z gameplay videos we fixed[/b].

[list]
[*] [h2]Adding two difficulty modes & picture mode[/h2]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38611626/d194f7a289d3b063445fbd40bb707731194b8e0e.png[/img]

For those who found the difficult mode not so challenging and found it easy to complete the game, [b]we added two new difficulty modes[/b], the [b]Very hard mode[/b] and the [b]Veteran mode[/b]. So if you found the game too easy even on hard difficulty, it will be a great time to try something more challenging.

[b]We also added the picture mode[/b], which can be used to take images of specific locations in the game, where you can change the lighting, fly, pass objects, etc.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


We would like to thank all the efforts that the community has been making so that we can improve the game even more, [b]it is very important the feedback from all of you so that we can bring new things and fix/improve things that are not good for you[/b].

[i][b][u]Let's recover ZPriot! ːsteamhappyː[/u][/b][/i]
